issues.body:
## Observed boundary

The unchanged desktop-app source fails `music-player walk_order::tests::a_file_that_is_not_listed_lands_where_the_walk_would_put_it` on macOS Intel.
The assertion is at `package/music-player/desktop-app/src/walk_order_tests.rs:75:13`.
The complete nextest recovery uses the original package task and environment with only `--no-fail-fast` added in memory.
This records the failing test boundary. It does not establish a shared cause with other keyboard, focus, watcher, or fixture failures.

## Reproduction evidence

- Source `cb95cf6d785c3073c192b95f0632cdae7b910894`: [run 38847322477, job 116800698226](https://github.com/Aquaticats/Monochromatic/actions/runs/38847322477/job/116800698226), log line 4476.

```text
// Provider assertion output; temporary fixture roots shortened where present.
thread 'walk_order::tests::a_file_that_is_not_listed_lands_where_the_walk_would_put_it' (220688) panicked at src/walk_order_tests.rs:75:13:
assertion `left == right` failed: seed 1: b/A/ß/1 probe 9.flac lands at its place
left: None
right: Some(23)
```

Both macOS complete runs retained every eligible identity and preserved failing exit status. Release build, release CLI consumer invocation, exact-toolchain Clippy prerequisite check, and source immutability checks passed; Clippy source diagnostics are separate.

## Required investigation

Reproduce this exact test on macOS through the package test task. Determine whether the assertion, platform contract, or application behavior needs correction, preserving the named interaction.
Retain the triggering input and expected/actual state before changing production behavior or weakening coverage.

## Duplicate search

Searched the titles and bodies of all 1049 repository issues, open and closed, through issue #1081, using the complete test identity and assertion boundary. No existing issue records this test.
Full per-test evidence and exact failure blocks: `doc/audit/depot-native-recovery-2026-10-17.evidence.json`.
